about: Misthalin piece 7 step 12a: the NPCs the sweep found on mejrs's Misthalin tiles that no other file spawns and no other piece has taken. North-west of Lumbridge Castle, a camp of level 2 goblins (12, and one more north of the castle by the river; the Wiki's Goblin page lists every tile under Lumbridge), two giant spiders and the woods' butterflies (8); a goblin south-east of Draynor Village, one south of Draynor Manor and the level 5 goblin at the Digsite's west edge; a giant spider between Falador and Draynor Manor; the highwayman south of Draynor Manor; the mugger at the South-west Varrock mine; and three Black Knights, one south of Draynor Village bank and two north of Varrock. Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json, each tile also on the NPC's Wiki location map (butterflies have none), checked against every other spawn file (none within 2 tiles of the same NPC). Every wander range is guessed until recorded. Left out, with why: Nigel and Gelin by Lumbridge church (Deadman forms only; Nigel stands at the Grand Exchange on normal worlds), Twiggy O'Korn and her squirrel south of Draynor bank (the Achievement Diaries master; diaries aren't built), Spria in Draynor (a Slayer master, for the Slayer thread), the Draynor gulls (the 242 cache gave their old ids to Sailing NPCs, so which gull stands there now can't be read), and the General's Shadow scout (a miniquest NPC). The Varrock and Grand Exchange people the sweep found are the Varrock piece's.
